officialTitle: Integrated Master of Arts in Economics

eligibleAudiences: Indian applicants meeting the academic and age requirements
Foreign nationals through the self-financing direct-application route
restrictions: The 2026 academic and age conditions apply; an offer depends on the appropriate selection route.
Foreign applicants submit qualifications and bio-data directly to the designated MSE office; do not assume the Indian entrance-test route applies.

admissionsContent.overview: A five-year integrated economics programme with a three-year BA Honours exit and a four-year BA Honours with Research exit. Indian and foreign self-financing applicants follow different admission procedures.

eligibility.intro: Admission depends on the qualification and applicant-category requirements for this programme.
items: Pass the qualifying 10+2 examination on the first attempt; the 2026 brochure specifies the final 2026 academic-year cohort.
Minimum 65% for General, 60% for OBC-NCL and 50% for SC/ST/PwD applicants, or equivalent grades.
Mathematics at 10+2 is mandatory; Standard, Applied or Business Mathematics is accepted.
Applicants must be under 22 on 1 July 2026.
Foreign applicants meet the same minimum qualifications; obtain AIU equivalence if the qualification is not on its recognised list.

applicationSteps: Check the programme’s exact academic, mathematics and age conditions before applying.
Indian applicants submit the online MSE form and take the designated entrance test.
Foreign self-financing applicants send the prescribed application, bio-data and academic qualifications directly to the designated MSE Students Office.
Complete qualification verification and pay the applicable category-specific fees if selected.

academic: Records establishing the required mathematics study
Attested English translations and AIU equivalence where required for foreign records
application: Bio-data and academic qualification details for foreign self-financing applicants

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: The cited admissions rules concern the 2026 cycle. Do not treat its closed application dates as a future intake announcement.

reportedFeeQuote.componentBasis: Published semester fee including tuition, examination and other components; infrastructure INR 30,000 and one-time admission INR 5,000 are additional.

fee.notes: The domestic 2026–27 semester fee is INR 72,600 including tuition, examinations and other components, plus INR 30,000 infrastructure and a one-time INR 5,000 admission charge. SC/ST semester-fee concession is 20%. Foreign/NRI prices are referred to a separate handbook and are not established for this cycle.

restrictions: The 2026 academic and age conditions apply; an offer depends on the appropriate selection route.

admissionsContent.overview: A two-year data-science programme with quantitative coursework, a mandatory summer internship and a second-year dissertation. Indian and foreign self-financing applicants follow different admission procedures.

eligibility.intro: Admission depends on the qualification and applicant-category requirements for this programme.
items: An undergraduate degree in social sciences, including commerce/management, sciences or engineering, or mathematics/statistics.
Minimum undergraduate marks: 55% General, 50% OBC-NCL and 45% SC/ST/PwD.
Applicants must be under 25 on 1 July 2026.
Mathematics at 10+2 or equivalent, or undergraduate mathematical-economics coursework, is required.
For the GATE route, accepted papers are CS, DA, MA, ST or PH; MSE also runs its own entrance route.

applicationSteps: Check the programme’s exact academic, mathematics and age conditions before applying.
Indian applicants submit the online MSE form and take the designated entrance test; eligible applicants may instead use the specified GATE papers, with no more than half the seats through GATE.
Foreign self-financing applicants send the prescribed application, bio-data and academic qualifications directly to the designated MSE Students Office.
Complete qualification verification and pay the applicable category-specific fees if selected.
